candidate_accounts.speaker: Quintus

candidate_accounts.account: Grouped with preceding portent by Quintus.

candidate_accounts.speaker: Marcus reporting criticized practice
candidate_accounts.account: Reported as extremely unpropitious by practitioners.
candidate_accounts.qualification: Marcus reports belief while criticizing inference; source polarity only.

roman.critical_context: II.12.28–29 Marcus distinguishes political/institutional use from truth and notes differences among nations. II.14.33–34 challenges natural links to wealth; II.15.35–36 critiques divine selection and changing signs; II.16.36–37 disputes vanished-heart inference and suggests disease. Ancient speculation is not a modern biological diagnosis.
roman.terminology_gate: Freeze source-language caput/cleft/heart/lung terminology,exact native chapter/section and translation layer before coding; no confident modern anatomical equivalents imported from Mesopotamian/Etruscan reconstructions.
